name: Our Home Dormitory
address: 2023 Ricarte St., Brgy. South Cembo, Makati City (near St. Luke's BGC)
description: Bunk-bed dormitory in South Cembo aimed at young professionals working around BGC. Rooms are air-conditioned with lockers, drawers and foam mattresses, and the building has a passenger elevator and a roof deck.
houseRules: 1 month advance and 1 month deposit; 2 government IDs required.

name: Milflores Lady Bedspace
address: B70 L31 Milflores St., Brgy. Rizal, Makati City, near INC Lokal ng Pembo
description: Third-floor bedspace for ladies in Barangay Rizal with a mattress and lockable cabinet for each bed. Residents share a bathroom, kitchen and a rooftop laundry area, and the market and SM Aura are a tricycle ride away.
houseRules: 1 month advance and 1 month deposit; government ID, company ID and emergency contact required; viewing 11am-5pm daily.

name: East Rembo Female Bedspace near BGC
description: Newly built female bedspace in East Rembo, a short ride from BGC, Market Market and McKinley. Each room has its own bathroom with a bidet and beds come with foam, sheets and pillows.

name: Link Living Filmore
address: Filmore St. cor. Casino St., Palanan, Makati City
description: Co-living dormitory in Palanan offering plug-and-play furnished rooms with quality furniture and appliances. Built for workers and students who want a contemporary, hassle-free place near major roads and offices.

name: The Wood Ridge Residences at McKinley
address: Upper McKinley Rd, Pinagsama, Taguig City (McKinley Hill, near Venice Piazza)
description: Six-storey mid-rise dormitory split into two clusters, with air-conditioned units furnished with double-deck beds. Ground-floor stalls include a 24-hour convenience store, laundry shop and eateries, serving students and workers around Fort Bonifacio.

name: Urbanspace Co-Living Pasig (Bridgetowne)
address: Amang Rodriguez Avenue, Brgy. Rosario, Pasig City, near Bridgetowne and IPI
description: Modern co-living building with furnished dorm rooms for young professionals, offered in 2-, 4-, 6- and 8-bed layouts. The 8-bed all-male standard room is the cheapest, and all-female rooms are also available.

name: VM Dormitory
address: Brgy. Malamig, Mandaluyong City, near MRT Boni and RTU
description: Home-style dormitory for female students and professionals, within reach of RTU, Boni Market and Robinsons Pioneer. It has an in-house canteen and round-the-clock CCTV.

name: CITIHUB Dormitory Mandaluyong Branch
address: J.P. Rizal Street, Mabini-J. Rizal, Mandaluyong City
description: Budget dorm built from container vans, with 22 double-deck beds per room. Every bed has its own window, hanging rod, drawer, locker and curtain, and separate container units serve as toilets and showers.

name: Lead Ladies Dormitory
address: Bulusan Street, Brgy. Mauway, Mandaluyong City, near MRT Boni and Megamall
description: Ladies-only dormitory a few minutes on foot from Robinsons Supermarket and banks. MRT Boni and Shaw stations, EDSA, Megamall and Starmall are all within a short walk.
